exceptions.rationale: Re-reviewed 2026-11-04 (America/Chicago) against fresh OSV and RustSec data and the checksum-verified locked sources. RUSTSEC-2024-0436 remains an unmaintained-crate advisory with no patched version and no reported exploitable defect. tokenizers 0.22.2 is the sole direct caller of paste 1.0.15, a compile-time proc macro: ctx-semantic-model reaches tokenizers through fastembed 5.17.2 and directly on macOS. Its two paste invocations generate serde helper identifiers from source-defined struct names; runtime history and model inputs are not macro inputs. No compatible upstream has removed this dependency since the 2026-11-01 review: tokenizers 0.22.2 remains the latest compatible release, and current stable tokenizers 0.23.2 still requires paste, including through latest fastembed 7.5.0. tokenizers 1.0.0-rc.3 removes the direct edge but replaces the tokenizer API and is outside both FastEmbed requirements. Track migration to tokenizers 1.0 with coordinated embedding and Core ML changes, or to a compatible maintained pastey-based upstream; validate numerical embedding compatibility and existing-index reuse before removing this exception. Accept the exact locked build-time maintenance risk only through 2027-02-05. Re-evaluate before expiry or when a compatible upstream removes the dependency.
